BiblicalUsage: Darkness in the Old Testament is more than night. Job calls for darkness to seize the night of his birth, and describes the land of the shadow of death where even the light is as darkness, while Isaiah promises that the blind shall see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe darkness is the Bible's picture of what life is without God, and the promise is that His light breaks into it — the blind see, and the land of darkness does not have the last word. The darkness is real, but it is not final, because the light that shines in it has never gone out.
